concepts.explanation: Two particles linked so that measuring one instantly determines the other's state, however far apart.
A quantum system existing in several states at once until it is measured.
The wave function describes all possible states of a particle; measuring it collapses them to one outcome.
You cannot know both a particle's exact position and momentum at once. Precision in one blurs the other.
Thought experiment: a cat both alive and dead until observed, illustrating how odd quantum superposition is.
Einstein's theory that gravity is the bending of space and time by mass and energy.
A measure of disorder. It always increases in a closed system, which is why time seems to run one way.
Splitting heavy atoms to release energy. Powers nuclear reactors and atomic bombs.
Fusing light atoms to release energy, as the Sun does. Far harder to sustain than fission.
Uranium processed to raise the share of the fissile isotope. Low levels fuel reactors; high levels make bombs.
The boundary of a black hole beyond which nothing, not even light, can escape.
Invisible matter detected only by its gravity, making up most of the universe's mass.
The molecule carrying genetic instructions in every cell. Unique enough to identify individuals.
A tool for precisely cutting and editing DNA, making genetic changes far cheaper and faster.
Traits that help survival and reproduction become more common over generations. The engine of evolution.
Scrambling data so only someone with the right key can read it.
A step-by-step set of rules a computer follows to solve a problem or make a decision.
Software that learns patterns from data rather than following hand-written rules.
An AI trained on vast text to predict and generate language. The technology behind chatbots.
A shared, tamper-resistant record of transactions copied across many computers.
Computers using quantum states to explore many possibilities at once, potentially cracking today's encryption.
A security flaw unknown to the software maker, so no fix exists yet when attackers use it.
Malware that locks a victim's files and demands payment to unlock them.
Computing and storage rented from remote data centres over the internet instead of owned hardware.
The material and chips at the heart of all electronics. Their supply chain is a major geopolitical issue.
The total greenhouse gas emitted by a person, product or activity.
Improvement caused by believing a treatment works, even when it has no active ingredient.
